post.description: Reads and drafts with the caller's own permissions. `receipts` lists what the application stored, whatever the answer says: STORED was read back with its own audit event, UNVERIFIED was not, UNKNOWN was not observed. `proposal` was not executed; sending `confirm <code>` in the same session executes exactly it, at most once. Both fields are sent only with `LBF-Assistant-Version: 2`, and are absent when empty. Version 1, the default, has the eight required fields only and states the same facts in `notice`, with `answer.draft_operation_id` naming a written draft. Treat `mode` as an open set of strings.

post.description: `Idempotency-Key` identifies the request, not its body. Repeating a key returns the first draft, its version and content hash with 201, also when the body differs; the new body is then ignored, so a 201 does not mean that this body was stored. Use a new key for every new intent and compare the returned `content_hash`. Keys are per user and are kept at least 24 hours. Without the header, every request creates a draft.
